en.headline: Social Welfare Department warns of fake messaging accounts
en.dek: The department urged the public not to reply to or click links from messaging-app accounts purporting to represent SWD service centres, after detecting phishing attempts to harvest personal data.
body: The Social Welfare Department on Friday called on members of the public to stay alert and avoid responding to messages from accounts on communication apps that claim to represent SWD service centres. The department said the accounts were attempting to trick people into replying or clicking unknown links in order to steal personal information.

SWD emphasised that it has no connection with the accounts in question and has referred the matter to the police for follow-up. Anyone who has already provided personal data to such accounts should contact the police immediately.

Members of the public with queries may call the department’s hotline on 2343 2255. Officials reiterated that legitimate government departments do not solicit personal information through unofficial messaging accounts.

zh.headline: 社署籲提防偽冒通訊應用程式帳戶
zh.dek: 社會福利署周五呼籲市民勿回覆自稱代表社署服務中心的通訊應用程式帳戶，或點擊不明連結，以免個人資料被盜。
body: 社會福利署周五表示，近日發現有人開設偽冒社署服務中心的通訊應用程式帳戶，企圖誘騙市民回覆訊息或點擊短訊內的不明連結，藉此盜取個人資料。
社署強調與該等帳戶並無任何關係，並已將事件交由警方跟進。任何市民若曾向有關帳戶提供個人資料，應立即聯絡警方。
如有查詢，可致電社署熱線2343 2255。當局提醒市民，政府部門不會透過非官方通訊帳戶索取個人資料。
